job.rawJd: Role Description: The AI Product Manager will play a key role in shaping AI-driven solutions that enhance MedSpa operations and client experiences. This part-time, remote role involves collaborating with clinical and business stakeholders to define product requirements, prioritize features, and translate user needs into clear, actionable roadmaps. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing user feedback and performance data, coordinating with technical teams on solution design, and overseeing product documentation and release planning. The AI Product Manager will also support go-to-market activities, contribute to training materials for MedSpa partners, and ensure that all AI features align with regulatory, ethical, and usability standards. Qualifications: Product management skills, including roadmap development, requirements gathering, and stakeholder communication. Understanding of AI/ML concepts, data-driven decision-making, and experience working with technical teams. Experience in or strong interest in the aesthetics, MedSpa, or broader healthcare domain. Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, user-centered solutions and documentation. Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills suitable for a part-time, remote environment. Effective written and verbal communication skills and comfort presenting to diverse audiences. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Product Management, Business, Computer Science, or Healthcare, or equivalent experience. Experience with agile methodologies, user research, and product analytics tools is highly beneficial.
